headline: 10 Michigan deals, $8.1M raised — led by Esperion Therapeutics, Inc.

top_deals.summary: Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with Essence Parent Inc.; filing cites a figure of ~$350M.
Haddon Rig Med-Tech Fund, LLC, a Grand Rapids-based private equity fund, disclosed a $50M raise; $848.5K sold to 2 investors. (Amended filing.)
Employ Intelligence, Inc., a Detroit-based company, filed a $8M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $5.8M sold to 11 investors.
Oha Sp 6.5, LLC, a Traverse City-based health care company, filed an indefinite-size equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.1M sold.
Hurdle6 Partners, LP, a Rochester-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $400K sold to 3 investors. (Amended filing.)

material_agreements.summary: Dynamic Aerospace Systems Corp (BRQL) entered into a material definitive agreement (equity financing).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $8.1M sold across 5 Form D filings this week, down 85% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Employ Intelligence, Inc. (Detroit, Other) targeting $8M. Good question to ask: are founders in other favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) disclosed a deal with Essence Parent Inc.. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan health care & life sciences assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $1.2M raised so far — led by Haddon Rig Med-Tech Fund, LLC (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
